body:
User asked (verbatim):
  fist let do the  simple middle option

Context:
  Conversation thread: sign-in chains (staging-app -> api.workos.com -> auth.franchiseatlas.ai -> independent-tea-80-staging.authkit.app) leak the browser's login into personas until every host is allowed one by one; user: 'ok great i tworked but no user will ever know this lol / we need to smooth the whole flow' and 'why e canno default allow all the sites'. The middle option agreed: keep the manifest with no host permissions; ask once on first run (welcome) and in Settings: 'Let Tabsona keep logins separate on every website? [Allow on all sites] [I'll choose sites myself]', one Chrome prompt for all sites via optional permission.
  Related: tsk_01a12074f9e37474b762abe67088e6f6.

Acceptance:
  A new user can grant all sites with one click on first run or from Settings, and can revoke it; with it granted, adding a site to a persona that signs in through other hosts opens signed out with no host prompts.
title: Ask once to allow Tabsona on all sites (first run + Settings)
